Geometric19C.corrected_geometric_shell_eventually_reconstructs.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  (S : Finset (Geometric19C.FinitePlace K)) (P : ℕ → Finset (Geometric19C.FinitePlace K)) (hzero : P 0 = ∅)
  (hmono : Monotone P) (hcover : ∀ (v : Geometric19C.FinitePlace K), v ∉ S ↔ ∃ n, v ∈ P n)
  (kernel : Geometric19C.Ideles K → Geometric19C.Ideles K → ℂ) (x y : Geometric19C.Ideles K) :
  ∀ᶠ (N : ℕ) in atTop,
    Geometric19C.outsideMask K S y * kernel x y +
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, (Geometric19C.unitMask K (P n) y - Geometric19C.unitMask K (P (n + 1)) y) * kernel x y =
      kernel x y
'Geometric19C.corrected_geometric_shell_eventually_reconstructs' depends on axioms: [propext,
 Classical.choice,
 Quot.sound]
Geometric19C.unitMask_eventually_eq_outsideMask.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  (S : Finset (Geometric19C.FinitePlace K)) (P : ℕ → Finset (Geometric19C.FinitePlace K)) (hmono : Monotone P)
  (hcover : ∀ (v : Geometric19C.FinitePlace K), v ∉ S ↔ ∃ n, v ∈ P n) (g : Geometric19C.Ideles K) :
  ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in atTop, Geometric19C.unitMask K (P n) g = Geometric19C.outsideMask K S g

Geometric19C.corrected_shell_diagonal_integral_limit.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  [MeasurableSpace (Geometric19C.Ideles K)] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure (Geometric19C.Ideles K))
  (S : Finset (Geometric19C.FinitePlace K)) (P : ℕ → Finset (Geometric19C.FinitePlace K)) (hzero : P 0 = ∅)
  (hmono : Monotone P) (hcover : ∀ (v : Geometric19C.FinitePlace K), v ∉ S ↔ ∃ n, v ∈ P n)
  (kernel : Geometric19C.Ideles K → Geometric19C.Ideles K → ℂ) (hint : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y => kernel y y) μ)
  (hmeas :
    ∀ (N : ℕ), MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun y => (1 - Geometric19C.unitMask K (P N) y) * kernel y y) μ) :
  Tendsto
    (fun N =>
      ∫ (y : Geometric19C.Ideles K),
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, (Geometric19C.unitMask K (P n) y - Geometric19C.unitMask K (P (n + 1)) y) * kernel y y ∂μ)
    atTop (nhds (∫ (y : Geometric19C.Ideles K), (1 - Geometric19C.outsideMask K S y) * kernel y y ∂μ))

Geometric19C.corrected_indented_shell_integral_limit.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  [MeasurableSpace (Geometric19C.Ideles K × Kˣ)] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure (Geometric19C.Ideles K × Kˣ))
  (S : Finset (Geometric19C.FinitePlace K)) (P : ℕ → Finset (Geometric19C.FinitePlace K)) (hzero : P 0 = ∅)
  (hmono : Monotone P) (hcover : ∀ (v : Geometric19C.FinitePlace K), v ∉ S ↔ ∃ n, v ∈ P n)
  (kernel : Geometric19C.Ideles K → Geometric19C.Ideles K → ℂ)
  (hint : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun z => kernel z.1 (Geometric19C.principalIdele K z.2 * z.1)) μ)
  (hmeas :
    ∀ (N : ℕ),
      MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable
        (fun z =>
          (1 - Geometric19C.unitMask K (P N) (Geometric19C.principalIdele K z.2 * z.1)) *
            kernel z.1 (Geometric19C.principalIdele K z.2 * z.1))
        μ) :
  Tendsto
    (fun N =>
      ∫ (z : Geometric19C.Ideles K × Kˣ),
        ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N,
          (Geometric19C.unitMask K (P n) (Geometric19C.principalIdele K z.2 * z.1) -
              Geometric19C.unitMask K (P (n + 1)) (Geometric19C.principalIdele K z.2 * z.1)) *
            kernel z.1 (Geometric19C.principalIdele K z.2 * z.1) ∂μ)
    atTop
    (nhds
      (∫ (z : Geometric19C.Ideles K × Kˣ),
        (1 - Geometric19C.outsideMask K S (Geometric19C.principalIdele K z.2 * z.1)) *
          kernel z.1 (Geometric19C.principalIdele K z.2 * z.1) ∂μ))
